tells.1: Slightly templated three-bullet stack and a neat rule-of-three closer, with almost no personal voice.
tells.2: Stock lines like "Never miss a session again" and "watch your progress grow!" plus mangled auto-renew wording.
tells.3: Over-smoothed wellness cadence: "get moving," "keep you moving forward," "how far you've come."
tells.4: Empty filler "unlock more of what the app has to offer" and interchangeable recovery phrasing.
tells.5: Dropped-in named outcome ("Gwen Harper... back to hiking in four months") reads like invented social proof.

reason: Version 5 has the most individual voice, but the unverified recovery claim and shifted exercise count are not publishable. Version 1 is clear, compliant, and credible without unsupported extras.
